verses.tl: Wa inna laka la-ajran ghayra mamnoon
Inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman dalla an sabeelihi wa huwa a'lamu bil-muhtadeen
Wa laa tuti kulla hallaafin maheen
An kaana dhaa maalin wa baneen
Idhaa tutlaa alayhi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul-awwaleen
Innaa balawnaahum kamaa balawnaa ashaabal-jannati idh aqsamoo layasrimunnahaa musbiheen
Fataafa alayhaa taa'ifun min rabbika wa hum naa'imoon
Anigh-doo alaa harthikum in kuntum saarimeen
Qaala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum lawlaa tusabbihoon
Qaaloo subhaana rabbinaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
Qaaloo yaa waylanaa innaa kunnaa taagheen
Asaa rabbunaa an yubdilanaa khayran minhaa innaa ilaa rabbinaa raaghiboon
Kadhaalikal-adhaabu wa la-adhaabul-aakhirati akbaru law kaanoo ya'lamoon
Am lakum aymaanun alaynaa baalighatun ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati inna lakum lamaa tahkumoon
Am lahum shurakaa'u falya'too bishurakaa'ihim in kaanoo saadiqeen
Yawma yukshafu an saaqin wa yud'awna ilas-sujoodi falaa yastatee'oon
Khaashi'atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun wa qad kaanoo yud'awna ilas-sujoodi wa hum saalimoon
Fadharnee wa man yukadhdhibu bihadhal-hadeethi sanastadrijuhum min haythu laa ya'lamoon
Wa umlee lahum inna kaydee mateen
Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloon
Fasbir lihukmi rabbika wa laa takun kasaahibil-hooti idh naadaa wa huwa makzoom
Lawlaa an tadaarakahu ni'matun min rabbihi lanubidha bil-araa'i wa huwa madhmoom
Wa in yakaadul-ladheena kafaroo layuzliqoonaka bi-absaarihim lammaa sami'udh-dhikra wa yaqooloona innahu lamajnoon
Wa maa huwa illaa dhikrun lil-aalameen
